patch:
diff --git a/solution.sh b/solution.sh
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..15fff8c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/solution.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Count the number of lines read from stdin.
+count=0
+while read -r line; do
+  count=$((count + 1))
+done
+echo "$count"
prompt: The script solution.sh counts how many lines it reads from stdin, but it's off by one when the input doesn't end with a newline — the last unterminated line gets missed. Fix it so the count is correct whether or not the input ends in a newline (an empty input should count as 0 lines). Run it like: printf 'a\nb\nc' | bash solution.sh
